title: Madine Mein Yeh Lut Kar Qafila Aaya Hai Ae Sughra (s.a)
body:
Bataya Madar-e-Abbas Ne Sughra Ko Ro Ro Kar

Meri Bimaar Beti Dil Pe Rakh Le Sabr Ka Patthar
